title: Hand sketches of disc-shaped object, edge-on and plan view, below typed sighting report
description: Faded typed page of a sighting report (largely illegible) with two hand-drawn outlines at the bottom: a thin elongated lens shape (edge-on view) and a rounded, slightly shield-shaped outline with a small arrow beneath it (plan view). A typed note at lower right reads "They seemed longer than wide, thickness being about 1/20 of width".
